project.name: coh-sidekick
project.description: City of Heroes character build planner — React/TypeScript web app with multi-server game-data layer, character stat calculation engine, and build sharing. (Graph scope: src/ non-test files plus first-wave extras.)

nodes.name: bulk-import-mids.ts
nodes.summary: CLI script that bulk-imports Mids Reborn .mbd build files into the Supabase shared_builds table, with Discord-username lookup, dry-run mapping reports, resume state, and aggregated warning reporting.

nodes.name: runImport
nodes.summary: Main import loop: walks .mbd files, parses each via importMidsBuild, serializes the build to a shareable row, and inserts into shared_builds with resume state and per-file failure logging.

nodes.name: buildToRow
nodes.summary: Converts a parsed build into a shared_builds row, slimming and hash-encoding the build plus metadata columns for insertion.

nodes.name: lookupDiscordUsername
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase auth.users for Discord usernames matching a search string and prints candidate user UUIDs for the --user-id flag.

nodes.name: walkMbdFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory tree collecting .mbd file paths to import.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry: parses arguments and dispatches between username-lookup, dry-run, and real-import modes.

nodes.name: WarningAggregator
nodes.summary: Aggregates Mids-import warnings across all processed files and renders a Markdown report grouped by warning type with occurrence counts.

nodes.name: IncarnateSlotButton.tsx
nodes.summary: React button component for a single incarnate slot in the incarnate panel, showing the slotted power icon, tier-colored ring, and active-toggle state.

nodes.name: IncarnateSlotButton
nodes.summary: Renders one incarnate slot button with slot/tier coloring from the incarnate registry, selection state, and toggle-active interaction.

nodes.name: ExportImportModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Large modal handling every build export/import path: shareable build-hash links, Mids .mbd and .mxd imports, in-game export parsing, forum/popmenu/print exports, and shared-build cloud publishing via Supabase.

nodes.name: ExportImportModal
nodes.summary: Top-level export/import modal component: tabbed UI orchestrating build serialization, multiple import parsers with warning display, enhancement-legality validation, and share-link management.

nodes.name: PowersetCompareModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal that compares two powersets side by side, auto-pairing analogous powers and charting per-power metrics such as damage per activation and DPS.

nodes.name: classifyPower
nodes.summary: Buckets a power into a comparison category (single-target attack, AoE, control, buff, etc.) based on its type and effects.

nodes.name: calculateMetric
nodes.summary: Computes the selected comparison metric (damage, damage-per-activation, DPS, endurance efficiency) for a power using the damage calculation utilities.

nodes.name: formatMetricValue
nodes.summary: Formats a metric value for display with unit-appropriate precision.

nodes.name: autoPairPowers
nodes.summary: Pairs powers from the two compared powersets by level and category so analogous powers align on the same comparison row.

nodes.name: ComparisonBarRow
nodes.summary: Renders one paired-power comparison row with proportional metric bars for each powerset.

nodes.name: PowersetCompareModal
nodes.summary: Top-level comparison modal managing powerset/metric selection state and rendering the paired comparison list.

nodes.name: SlottedSetBonuses.tsx
nodes.summary: Small wrapper component that renders the active IO set bonuses for a single slotted power via SetBonusList.

nodes.name: SlottedSetBonuses
nodes.summary: Derives the IO sets slotted into a power and delegates rendering of their active bonuses to SetBonusList.

nodes.name: Select.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable styled select-dropdown UI component with a simple options-array API, used across modals and settings panels.

nodes.name: Select
nodes.summary: Styled native select element accepting an options array and change callback.

nodes.name: adaptation-stance-collision.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test ensuring Bio Armor adaptation stance sub-powers no longer collide by internalName during Mids import (stance desync fix).

nodes.name: adaptation-stance-gating.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that Bio Armor adaptation stance effects are gated per stance and do not leak into the base always-on effect set.

nodes.name: ally-range-buff.test.ts
nodes.summary: Dataset test verifying ally-targeted range buff powers are represented correctly in the converted data.

nodes.name: alpha-enhances-destiny.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that Alpha incarnate enhancement bonuses apply to Destiny powers only for allowed boost categories (e.g. Ageless is recovery-only).

nodes.name: archetype-stats.test.ts
nodes.summary: Validates archetype base stats and modifier tables in the active dataset against exported attribute data.

nodes.name: archetypes.ts
nodes.summary: Archetype data facade exposing the active dataset’s archetype registry plus lookup helpers by id, faction, and epic/standard grouping.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses JS Proxy wrappers (objectProxy/arrayProxy) so exported constants like ARCHETYPES live-swap when the active dataset changes at runtime.

nodes.name: bio-armor-naming.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test for Bio Armor power naming and display-name mapping in the dataset.

nodes.name: atom-query.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the atomic-effect query helpers (atomsOf, byType, resistible twins, per-target values) over synthetic encoded atoms.

nodes.name: incarnate-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized data-driven incarnate registry: slot and tier configuration (colors, icon folders, toggleability, level shifts), tree descriptions, the 5-column tree layout, and display helpers.

nodes.name: resolveTreeRow
nodes.summary: Resolves which incarnate powers occupy each column of a tree layout row for the standard 5-column grid.

nodes.name: abbreviatePowerName
nodes.summary: Shortens incarnate power names for compact display using the registry’s abbreviation rules.

nodes.name: movement-constants.ts
nodes.summary: Movement speed bases, caps, and mph-per-scale conversions per the HC wiki, with helpers to compute effective caps (including cap-raising bumps) and apply movement buffs.

nodes.name: getEffectiveMovementCaps
nodes.summary: Computes the effective movement cap for each movement type, folding in cap-raising bumps from powers such as Afterburner.

nodes.name: applyMovementBuff
nodes.summary: Applies a percentage movement buff to a base speed and clamps the result to the effective cap.

nodes.name: dataset.ts
nodes.summary: Multi-server dataset plumbing: defines the Dataset contract and the single active-dataset indirection (loadDataset/getActiveDataset) that lets Homecoming, Rebirth, and Thunderspy data swap transparently at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Every src/data/*.ts facade reads through getActiveDataset(), so consumers keep static import paths while the underlying dataset chunk is dynamically loaded per server.

nodes.name: getActiveDataset
nodes.summary: Returns the currently active Dataset object, throwing if no dataset has been loaded yet; the single read-point for all data facades.

nodes.name: validateDataset
nodes.summary: Sanity-checks a loaded dataset’s shape (required registries present and non-empty) before it becomes active.

nodes.name: loadDataset
nodes.summary: Dynamically imports the dataset chunk for a server id, validates it, and activates it as the current dataset.

nodes.name: destiny-decay.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the Destiny incarnate decay timeline: tiered effect values over time, total duration, and sustained-floor behavior.

nodes.name: domination-per-effect.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying Domination applies its mez bonus per effect with correct magnitude scaling.

nodes.name: domination-perma-classification.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests perma-Domination classification in the inherent and perma calculation utilities.

nodes.name: dormant-pools.test.ts
nodes.summary: Ensures dormant (hidden/unreleased) power pools are excluded from the active pool registry.

nodes.name: dormant-powersets.test.ts
nodes.summary: Ensures dormant powersets are excluded from the active powerset registry.

nodes.name: epic-pools-availability.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests epic/patron pool availability rules per archetype against the active dataset.

nodes.name: epic-pools.ts
nodes.summary: Epic/Patron pool facade: transforms the active dataset’s raw epic-pool registry into Power/PowerPool shapes and implements archetype gating, level-35 unlock, and per-power tier-prerequisite availability rules.

nodes.name: transformEpicPower
nodes.summary: Transforms a raw dataset epic power record into the app’s Power shape, mapping effects, enhancement categories, and prerequisites.

nodes.name: transformEpicPool
nodes.summary: Wraps a set of transformed epic powers into an EpicPool object with pool-level metadata.

nodes.name: poolArchetypeGate
nodes.summary: Determines the archetype gate for an epic pool (hero epic vs villain patron vs archetype-specific).

nodes.name: getEpicPoolsForArchetype
nodes.summary: Returns the epic/patron pools available to an archetype, applying archetype gating and dataset-specific rules.

nodes.name: isEpicPowerAvailable
nodes.summary: Checks whether an epic power can be taken at a given level, honoring tier prerequisites and picks already made within the pool.

nodes.name: genesis-incarnate.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the Genesis incarnate slot data: tier inference, branches, and exemplar effects.

nodes.name: globalboost-not-selectable.test.ts
nodes.summary: Ensures global-boost pseudo-powers are not selectable as power picks and survive build serialization round-trips.

nodes.name: granted-damage-procs.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests granted-power damage proc handling in the calculation pipeline.

nodes.name: incarnate-effects.ts
nodes.summary: Curated incarnate power effect lookup (Alpha, Destiny, Hybrid, Interface, Judgement, Lore, Genesis) read from the active dataset, including Destiny decay timelines and Alpha-boost application to Destiny powers.

nodes.name: getDestinySustainedFloorTime
nodes.summary: Computes when a Destiny buff reaches its sustained-floor tier within the decay timeline.

nodes.name: getDestinyEffectsAtTime
nodes.summary: Returns Destiny effect values at a given time since activation by walking the additive decay-timeline tiers.

nodes.name: applyAlphaToDestiny
nodes.summary: Applies slotted Alpha enhancement bonuses to Destiny effect values, gated by each Destiny power’s boosts_allowed categories.

nodes.name: getIncarnateEffects
nodes.summary: Dispatch helper returning the effect data for any incarnate power by slot id and power name across all incarnate trees.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the data layer, re-exporting archetypes, enhancements, IO sets, powersets, pools, epic pools, levels, incarnates, salvage, proc database, and effect-registry APIs.

nodes.name: inherent-rules.ts
nodes.summary: Facade forwarding per-server inherent power quirks (availability overrides, auto-granted slot levels and counts) from the active dataset.

nodes.name: inherent-slots.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests auto-granted inherent power slot counts (e.g. Rebirth’s auto-slotted Health/Stamina).

nodes.name: levels.ts
nodes.summary: Level/progression facade re-exporting the active dataset’s level rules and inherent power definitions, filtering per-server excluded inherents.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses direct `export * from` rather than runtime dataset indirection because primitive constants (MAX_LEVEL etc.) cannot be live-bound across module boundaries.

nodes.name: power-pools.ts
nodes.summary: Power pool facade: transforms the active dataset’s raw pool registry into PowerPool shapes and implements data-driven pool prerequisites, exclusion groups, unlock rules, and per-power availability.

nodes.name: transformPoolPower
nodes.summary: Transforms a raw dataset pool power record into the app’s Power shape, mapping effects, enhancement categories, and prerequisites.

nodes.name: transformPowerPool
nodes.summary: Wraps transformed pool powers into a PowerPool object with pool-level metadata.

nodes.name: _activeRegistry
nodes.summary: Memoizes the transformed pool registry per active dataset, rebuilding the cache when the dataset swaps.

nodes.name: arePoolPrerequisitesMet
nodes.summary: Data-driven check of a pool power’s prerequisites (picks within pool, level thresholds, mutually exclusive powers), replacing the old hard-coded pool gating.

nodes.name: isPowerAvailableInPool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a specific pool power is currently selectable given the build’s picks and prerequisites.

nodes.name: getAvailablePoolPowers
nodes.summary: Lists all pool powers available to the build at a given level, applying prerequisite and unlock rules.

nodes.summary: Root application component that simply mounts the TanStack Router via RouterProvider, delegating all page layout to the route tree.

nodes.name: buildTime.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes BUILD_TIME and APP_VERSION constants injected at build time, used for version display and diagnostics reporting.

nodes.name: Header.tsx
nodes.summary: The planner's main header: build identity popover, action menu (export/import/clear), settings popover, level-up mode and level slider, dataset badge, and archetype-specific mechanic controls (stances, Kheldian/Primalist forms, AT mechanics). Largest UI file in the batch, wiring together stores, dataset switching, and share services.
nodes.languageNotes: Single file hosting ~12 co-located React subcomponents rather than one component per file.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Top-level header component orchestrating modals, popovers, undo/redo history, and export/import actions for the planner.

nodes.name: countManualPowerPicks
nodes.summary: Counts non-inherent, manually chosen powers in a build, used to warn before destructive clear actions.

nodes.name: LevelUpModeButton
nodes.summary: Button and flow control for the level-up progression mode, guiding the user through pick/slot grants by level.

nodes.name: HeaderLevelSlider
nodes.summary: Exported slider control for the character's current level, shared between the header and other layouts.

nodes.name: BuildIdentityPopover
nodes.summary: Popover for editing build name/identity and handling share/quick-share of the current build via the sharedBuilds service.

nodes.name: ActionMenu
nodes.summary: Dropdown action menu exposing new/clear/export-image/enhancement-tools/about/changelog actions through callback props.

nodes.name: SettingsPopover
nodes.summary: Settings popover with dataset switching, display toggles, PWA install prompt, calc-debug toggle, and account/auth controls.

nodes.name: StanceSelector

nodes.name: ATMechanics
nodes.summary: Archetype-specific mechanic controls (Domination, Fury, Scourge, Supremacy, crit toggles, team-size sliders) bound to UI-store mechanic state.

nodes.name: SettingsLayout.tsx
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper for the settings pages, providing shared navigation chrome around an Outlet for settings routes.

nodes.name: SettingsLayout

nodes.summary: Walks every power slot in the build and flattens all slotted enhancements into a single list.

nodes.name: buildGroups
nodes.summary: Aggregates the flat enhancement list into deduplicated groups with counts, catalyst and booster tallies.

nodes.name: formatForClipboard
nodes.summary: Serializes the grouped enhancement list into a plain-text shopping list for clipboard copy.

nodes.name: EnhancementListModal
nodes.summary: Modal component rendering the grouped enhancement list with per-item auction prices fetched from the auctionPrices service.

nodes.name: FeedbackModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Feedback submission modal that captures user messages, optionally attaches a diagnostics snapshot and current build, and routes reports to the maintainer via Discord links or backend submission.

nodes.name: FeedbackModal
nodes.summary: Full feedback form flow: category selection, message entry, diagnostics/build attachment consent, and submission handling.

nodes.name: BuildCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Card component displaying a shared build's summary (archetype, powersets, author, views, tags) with favorite, delete, and visibility-toggle actions.

nodes.name: BuildCard
nodes.summary: Renders one shared build as a clickable card with owner actions (delete, visibility toggle) and favorite handling via the sharedBuilds service.

nodes.name: getTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Formats a date string as a human-readable relative time (e.g. '3 days ago') for card timestamps.

nodes.name: BuildFilters.tsx
nodes.summary: Filter bar for the shared-builds browser: archetype/powerset dropdowns, text search, and an author autocomplete backed by the profile service.

nodes.name: BuildFilters
nodes.summary: Controlled filter panel emitting SearchFilters changes for archetype, powersets, sort order, and text query.

nodes.name: Button.tsx

nodes.name: Input.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable text Input primitive wrapping a native input with consistent theming and forwardRef support.

nodes.summary: Color theme registry defining the available color themes and light/dark modes, plus DOM-applying helpers (applyColorTheme/applyColorMode) and type guards used at boot and in settings.

nodes.name: usePwaInstall

nodes.name: main.tsx

nodes.name: bootColorTheme
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted theme/mode preference and applies it to the document before React renders, avoiding a flash of wrong theme.

nodes.name: ErrorFallback
nodes.summary: Top-level error boundary fallback UI offering reload and reset options when the app crashes.

nodes.name: bootServerId
nodes.summary: Determines which game-server dataset (HC/Rebirth/Thunderspy) to load at startup from URL or persisted preference.

nodes.name: AuthorPage

nodes.summary: Detail page for a single shared build: shows metadata, powerset summaries, view counter, and actions to open the build in the planner, favorite it, or manage it as the owner.

nodes.name: BuildDetailPage
nodes.summary: Fetches the shared build by route id, increments views, and renders full metadata with load-into-planner and owner management actions.

nodes.name: PowersetSummary

nodes.name: BuildsPage.tsx

nodes.name: BuildsPage

nodes.name: GeneralSettings.tsx
nodes.summary: General settings page for theme/color-mode selection, calc-debug toggle, local data management, and account-related actions.

nodes.name: GeneralSettings
nodes.summary: Renders theme pickers, debug and display toggles, and destructive local-data reset actions bound to stores and theme helpers.

nodes.name: ProfileSettingsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Profile settings page where an authenticated user edits their handle, display name, and bio, enforcing handle cooldown rules via the profile service.

nodes.name: ProfileSettingsPage
nodes.summary: Loads the current user's profile, validates edits (handle regex, length limits, cooldown), and saves via updateProfile.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting all page components (Planner, Builds, BuildDetail, Author, settings pages, Import) for the router.

nodes.name: router.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the TanStack Router route tree: root with MainLayout, planner and shared-build routes, and a SettingsLayout subtree, exporting the configured router instance.

nodes.name: auctionPrices.ts
nodes.summary: Service mapping planner enhancements to raw auction-house identifiers and fetching current market prices from Supabase, with influence-value formatting helpers.

nodes.name: ioSetToRawIdentifier
nodes.summary: Converts an IO-set enhancement into the raw identifier string used by the auction price database.

nodes.name: fetchPrices
nodes.summary: Batch-fetches auction prices for a list of identifiers from the Supabase price table, returning a lookup map.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Thin auth service over the Supabase client: OAuth sign-in (Discord and others), sign-out, session/user getters, and an auth-state-change subscription.

nodes.name: signInWithProvider
nodes.summary: Starts an OAuth sign-in flow with the given provider, redirecting back to the app after authentication.

nodes.name: onAuthStateChange
nodes.summary: Subscribes a callback to Supabase auth state changes and returns an unsubscribe function.

nodes.name: profile.ts
nodes.summary: User profile service: fetch/update profiles with handle validation and change cooldown, plus author search and handle resolution for public author pages.

nodes.name: getProfile
nodes.summary: Fetches a user's profile row from Supabase by user id.

nodes.name: updateProfile
nodes.summary: Validates and persists profile updates (handle format, display name and bio limits) for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: searchAuthors
nodes.summary: Searches author profiles by handle/name prefix for the author autocomplete filter.

nodes.name: resolveAuthor
nodes.summary: Resolves an author handle from a URL into the full profile record for the AuthorPage.

nodes.name: sharedBuilds.ts
nodes.summary: Core service for the Supabase-backed shared-builds repository: share/quick-share with fingerprint caching, search, delete, visibility toggling, view counting, favorites with local/remote sync, anonymous owner tokens with claim-on-login, and rate-limit handling via a RateLimitError class.
nodes.languageNotes: Anonymous ownership is tracked with localStorage owner tokens that can later be claimed by an authenticated account; favorites are cached locally and synced to Supabase on login.

nodes.name: RateLimitError
nodes.summary: Error subclass carrying rate-limit action and retry information for share/delete operations, used to render friendly rate-limit messages.

nodes.name: toggleFavorite
nodes.summary: Toggles a build's favorite state in localStorage and persists the change to Supabase when logged in.

nodes.name: syncFavorites
nodes.summary: Merges locally stored favorites with the server-side favorites table after login, reconciling both directions.

nodes.name: getFavoriteBuilds
nodes.summary: Fetches the full shared-build records for all of the user's favorited build ids.

nodes.name: shareBuild
nodes.summary: Publishes a build to the shared repository with metadata, handling rate limits, owner-token issuance for anonymous shares, and update-vs-insert logic.

nodes.name: quickShareBuild
nodes.summary: One-click share that fingerprints the build export and reuses a cached share id when the identical build was already uploaded.

nodes.name: deleteBuild
nodes.summary: Deletes a shared build, authorizing either by authenticated ownership or by the locally held anonymous owner token.

nodes.name: getSharedBuild
nodes.summary: Fetches a single shared build by id, including joined author profile fields.

nodes.name: searchSharedBuilds
nodes.summary: Builds a filtered, sorted, paginated Supabase query over public shared builds from the SearchFilters object.

nodes.name: getMyBuilds
nodes.summary: Lists all builds owned by the current user, combining authenticated ownership and anonymous owner-token builds.

nodes.name: updateBuildVisibility
nodes.summary: Toggles a shared build between public search visibility and private vault, with ownership authorization.

nodes.name: claimBuilds
nodes.summary: After login, transfers ownership of anonymously shared builds (held via owner tokens) to the authenticated user account.

nodes.name: authStore.ts

nodes.name: shared.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the shared-builds feature: SharedBuild rows (with author-join fields), ShareBuildInput, and SearchFilters/SearchResult shapes used across services and pages.

nodes.name: calc-debug.ts
nodes.summary: Console-based calculation debug tracer: a localStorage-gated toggle plus a family of debug* helpers (grouped logging, formulas, set bonuses, scaled effects, hit chance, endurance math) sprinkled through the stat calculation pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: All helpers no-op unless the debug flag is enabled, so instrumentation can stay permanently in the calc code paths.

nodes.name: debugBuildContext
nodes.summary: Logs the calculation context (archetype, level, effective/exemplar level, options) at the start of a calc run.

nodes.name: debugSetBonuses
nodes.summary: Logs aggregated set-bonus values and per-stat tracking tables for rule-of-five inspection.

nodes.name: debugScaledEffect
nodes.summary: Logs how a scaled effect resolves through the AT table (scale, table value, level) to its final number.

nodes.name: debugHitChance
nodes.summary: Logs the full to-hit chain (base to-hit, bonuses, accuracy, level offset) leading to a final hit chance.

nodes.name: debugNetEndurance
nodes.summary: Logs the endurance economy breakdown: max end, recovery, toggle costs, discounts, and net end per second.

nodes.name: enhancement-values.ts
nodes.summary: Core enhancement math for the planner: IO value schedules by level, Enhancement Diversification (ED) curves, exemplar scaling, multi-aspect and set-rarity modifiers, IO-set piece parsing, and the per-power bonus aggregation including Alpha incarnate combination with ED bypass.
nodes.languageNotes: combineWithAlphaED applies the Alpha slot's partial ED bypass by re-running ED over enhancement + alpha with a bypass ratio, mirroring in-game behavior.

nodes.name: applyExemplarScaling
nodes.summary: Scales an enhancement's value down when exemplared below the IO's level, using the exemplar scaling table (procs exempt).

nodes.name: getIOValueAtLevel
nodes.summary: Returns the enhancement percentage a common IO grants at a given level for a schedule (A/B/C/D interpolation).

nodes.name: applyED
nodes.summary: Applies Enhancement Diversification diminishing returns to a total enhancement value using the schedule's breakpoints.

nodes.name: getEffectiveAspectCount
nodes.summary: Determines how many aspects an IO-set piece effectively enhances, accounting for procs and special pieces, to pick the multi-aspect modifier.

nodes.name: parseIOSetPieceValues
nodes.summary: Converts an IO-set piece's aspect list into concrete enhancement values at a level, applying multi-aspect and rarity multipliers.

nodes.name: filterAlphaByAllowedEnhancements
nodes.summary: Restricts Alpha incarnate bonuses to the enhancement types a power actually allows (boosts_allowed gating).

nodes.name: calculatePowerEnhancementBonuses
nodes.summary: Aggregates all slotted enhancements on a power into per-stat totals, applying IO schedules, exemplar scaling, and ED.

nodes.name: combineWithAlphaED
nodes.summary: Combines slotted enhancement totals with Alpha incarnate bonuses, honoring the Alpha ED-bypass ratio and allowed-enhancement gating per power.

nodes.name: handleChunkError

nodes.name: installChunkErrorReload
nodes.summary: Installs window error and unhandledrejection listeners that route chunk-load failures to the reload handler.

nodes.name: diagnostics.ts

nodes.name: getDiagnosticsSnapshot
nodes.summary: Collects app version, browser environment, and condensed build/UI store state into a serializable diagnostics object.

nodes.name: getPowersetsForArchetype

nodes.name: getPower
nodes.summary: Resolves an individual power by powerset id and power name.

nodes.name: getPowersAvailableAtLevel
nodes.summary: Lists the powers in a powerset that are unlockable at or below a given character level.

nodes.name: ImportPage

nodes.summary: Formats set-bonus values and descriptions for display: precision-aware percentage formatting and substitution of computed values into bonus description strings.

nodes.name: formatBonusDesc
nodes.summary: Rewrites a bonus description so its leading percentage reflects the actual computed value for the stat.

nodes.name: purple-patch.ts
nodes.summary: Purple Patch facade that forwards level-difference lookups (base ToHit, combat modifier, defense softcap) to whichever dataset is currently active, so servers like Rebirth can ship their own scaling tables without consumer changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin delegation layer preserving the legacy '@/data/purple-patch' import path while the real tables live per-dataset.

nodes.name: getBaseToHit
nodes.summary: Forwards base ToHit lookup by level difference to the active dataset's purple-patch table.

nodes.name: getCombatModifier
nodes.summary: Forwards the purple-patch combat modifier (damage/mez scaling by level difference) to the active dataset.

nodes.name: getDefenseSoftcap
nodes.summary: Forwards the defense softcap lookup for a level difference and content mode to the active dataset.

nodes.name: stance-groups.ts
nodes.summary: Registry of mutually-exclusive caster stance groups (Bio Armor Adaptation, Staff Fighting's Staff Mastery, etc.) plus helpers that derive the active stance from the parent power's activeSubPower field and map it to conditional-effect adjuster overrides for the dashboard calc.
nodes.languageNotes: Single source of truth pattern: the stance lives in the parent power's build-scoped activeSubPower field, and all consumers (dashboard calc, InfoPanel, stance selectors) derive from it.

nodes.name: stanceGroupForConditionalId
nodes.summary: Finds the stance group whose options include the given bare conditional id (e.g. 'defensiveadaptation').

nodes.name: findStanceParent
nodes.summary: Locates the selected parent power (e.g. Adaptation) for a stance group within the build's power list.

nodes.name: activeStanceOptionId
nodes.summary: Derives the active stance option's conditional id for a group from the parent power's activeSubPower selection.

nodes.name: stanceAdjusterOverrides
nodes.summary: Builds the conditional-id override map for every stance group in the build, feeding the dashboard calc's expandActiveConditionals.

nodes.name: useBuildMaxAttackDamage.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that computes the highest total final damage (direct + DoT, with each power's own slotting and global buffs) among the build's attack powers, used as the shared reference that normalizes damage bars across powers.

nodes.name: useBuildMaxAttackDamage
nodes.summary: Iterates all selected attack powers, applies per-power enhancement bonuses (with Alpha ED), quick-snipe conversion, and archetype context to find the build's hardest-hitting power's total damage; returns 0 when no damaging powers exist.

nodes.name: useCalculatedStats.ts
nodes.summary: Suite of React hooks exposing the unified character-totals calculation: legacy stat conversion, global bonuses, per-stat breakdowns, active set bonuses, Rule-of-5 tracking, slot usage, and over-cap offending-power reasons — all backed by a module-level single-entry shared cache so ~150 component instances don't recompute independently.
nodes.languageNotes: getSharedCharacterCalculation implements a module-level dep-tuple cache outside React, fixing a per-instance recalculation perf stall.

nodes.name: convertToLegacyStats
nodes.summary: Converts the unified CharacterStats calculation result into the legacy flat stats shape that older UI components consume.

nodes.name: _resetSharedCalcCache
nodes.summary: Test-only helper that clears the module-level shared calculation cache.

nodes.name: getSharedCharacterCalculation
nodes.summary: Module-level single-entry cache: returns the previous character-totals result when the dependency tuple is Object.is-equal, otherwise recomputes and stores it.

nodes.name: useCharacterCalculation
nodes.summary: Core hook that gathers build state and the many UI-store toggles (Domination, Fury, Stalker Hidden, etc.) and computes character totals through the shared cache via calculateCharacterTotals.

nodes.name: useCalculatedStats
nodes.summary: Returns character stats in the legacy shape by piping the shared calculation through convertToLegacyStats.

nodes.name: useGlobalBonuses
nodes.summary: Exposes the build's global bonuses (damage, recharge, etc.) from the shared character calculation.

nodes.name: useStatBreakdown
nodes.summary: Returns the per-source breakdown for a single named stat, used by dashboard tooltips.

nodes.name: useStatBreakdowns
nodes.summary: Returns the full stat-breakdown map from the shared calculation.

nodes.name: useTotalSlotsUsed
nodes.summary: Returns the total enhancement slots used across the build from the build store.

nodes.name: useSlotsRemaining
nodes.summary: Returns the enhancement slots still available to assign.

nodes.name: useActiveSetBonuses
nodes.summary: Lists the set bonuses currently active across slotted IO sets at their piece counts, resolving each set via getIOSet.

nodes.name: useBonusTracking
nodes.summary: Exposes the Rule-of-5 bonus tracking structure from the shared character calculation.

nodes.name: useOffendingPowerReasons
nodes.summary: Maps each power to the capped (Rule-of-5 over-cap) set-bonus reasons it contributes, via computeOffendingPowerReasons with the UI's mute state.

nodes.name: useOffendingPowerNames
nodes.summary: Returns just the names of powers contributing capped set bonuses.

nodes.name: useModeSuppression.ts
nodes.summary: React hook deriving the build's currently-suppressed powers (e.g. Granite Armor suspending other Stone toggles, Kheldian forms suspending human toggles) by feeding def-enriched build powers into the pure computeModeSuppression model, mirroring the totals calc so UI markers and numbers agree.

nodes.name: useModeSuppression
nodes.summary: Memoized hook returning the suppression map for the current build via collectCarriers and computeModeSuppression.

nodes.name: collectCarriers
nodes.summary: Collects the build's selected powers from primary/secondary/pools/epic, enriching each stored copy with its powerset definition so setsModes/modesSuspended flags are present even on lean build copies.

nodes.name: attack-chain-powers.ts
nodes.summary: Attack Chain Builder data-wiring layer: derives ChainPower[] and character endurance parameters from the live build, reusing the same calc functions the power tooltips use (enhancement bonuses, damage, ArcanaTime, procs, AT mechanics) so chain numbers match the rest of the app; pure scheduling math lives in attack-chain.ts.

nodes.name: collectCandidates
nodes.summary: Gathers candidate attack powers from the build's primary, secondary, pools, and epic pool selections.

nodes.name: resolveEffectDuration
nodes.summary: Resolves an effect's duration from keyed effect entries with fallback keys, handling duration-suffixed effect key variants.

nodes.name: selfEnduranceGain
nodes.summary: Computes the endurance a power restores to the caster per cast (drain/recovery powers), scaled by targets hit, end-mod enhancement, and the archetype AT table.

nodes.name: buildJudgementChainPower
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic ChainPower entry for the build's slotted Judgement incarnate nuke using incarnate damage tables and ArcanaTime.

nodes.name: buildChainPowers
nodes.summary: Main derivation: converts the live build's attacks into fully-enhanced ChainPower entries — three-tier recharge/endurance, damage with AT hit-time mechanics and proc damage, quick-snipe forms, buff/debuff windows, and per-power alternate forms — for the chain scheduler.

nodes.name: getEnduranceParams
nodes.summary: Derives the character's endurance simulation parameters (max end, recovery, toggle drain) from global bonuses.

nodes.name: getBuildGlobalRecharge
nodes.summary: Extracts the build's global recharge percentage from global bonuses.

nodes.name: sequenceToIds
nodes.summary: Serializes a chain sequence of power indices into stable power ids for persistence.

nodes.name: idsToSequence
nodes.summary: Deserializes stored power ids back into sequence indices, falling back to internalName matching when ids drift.

nodes.name: attack-chain.ts
nodes.summary: Attack Chain Builder pure timing/damage/endurance model with no app or data dependencies: a single-animation greedy scheduler (recharge starts at cast-end, matching in-game constraints), cycle DPS with post-cast DoT ticks, dead-gap analysis, and a spike-aware endurance simulation.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately dependency-free so the scheduling model is testable in isolation; callers feed pre-enhanced ChainPower data from attack-chain-powers.ts.

nodes.name: chainDotTickProbability
nodes.summary: Probability that DoT tick t fires, geometric for cancel-on-miss DoTs.

nodes.name: effectiveRecharge
nodes.summary: A power's recharge after applying global recharge percent, floored by the minimum recharge denominator.

nodes.name: effectiveStats
nodes.summary: Resolves the stats to use for an activation, selecting the matching alternate form (e.g. fast/slow snipe) when the activation carries one.

nodes.name: powerMetricValue
nodes.summary: Scores a power under the chosen ranking metric (nominal damage, damage-per-activation, etc.) for chain suggestions.

nodes.name: findSlot
nodes.summary: Finds the earliest legal start time for a power's next activation, respecting its recharge-after-cast-end constraint and the one-animation-at-a-time rule.

nodes.name: addActivation
nodes.summary: Appends an activation for a power at the earliest legal slot and keeps the activation list time-sorted.

nodes.name: removeLastActivation
nodes.summary: Removes the most recent activation of a given power from the timeline.

nodes.name: replayChain
nodes.summary: Replays a saved power sequence into a concrete activation timeline, tracking per-power form context (e.g. quick-snipe eligibility windows) while packing activations.

nodes.name: calcDeadGaps
nodes.summary: Computes the dead (no-animation) gaps between activations across one chain cycle.

nodes.name: activationDamage
nodes.summary: Damage attributed to one activation, including probability-weighted DoT ticks that land within the cycle.

nodes.name: simulateEndurance
nodes.summary: Simulates endurance over the chain cycle — continuous recovery minus toggle drain, with the lump end cost paid at each cast — producing a track that reveals when a spiky rotation bottoms out despite a positive average.

nodes.name: computeChain
nodes.summary: Computes full cycle metrics for an activation set: cycle length, DPS, dead-gap totals, per-power cast counts and uptime, metric scores, and endurance sustainability.

nodes.name: healing.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for extracting heals that powers store in their damage field as Heal-type entries (Life Drain, Reconstruction, DNA Siphon, ...), splitting the enhanceable portion from the IgnoreStrength-flagged unenhanceable portion; replaces logic previously duplicated in InfoPanel, PowerInfoTooltip, and CompareSlottingModal.

nodes.name: extractHealingFromDamage
nodes.summary: Filters Heal-type entries out of a power's damage array, summing same-table heal scales and tracking the IgnoreStrength portion that healing enhancements must not boost.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the entire calculations module surface (~140 symbols): damage and ArcanaTime, enhancement bonuses with ED, set bonuses and Rule-of-5 tracking, character totals, AT inherent mechanics (Fury, Scourge, Containment, crits, Domination), perma calculations, buff/debuff modifiers, and exemplar/incarnate level rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-export barrel with no local definitions; consumers import calc functions from '@/utils/calculations' rather than individual modules.

nodes.name: pet-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates DPS for summoned pets and pseudo-pets using pet class tables with the three-tier Base/Enhanced/Final display, including Mastermind upgrade tiers, resolved pseudo-pet damage with PvP/inherent-table filtering, non-damage effect synthesis, and AoE geometry resolution for proc calculations.

nodes.name: calculateAbilityBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes a pet ability's base damage per activation by resolving each damage entry against the pet class table at the given level.

nodes.name: calculateCycleTime
nodes.summary: Computes a pet ability's effective cycle time (cast plus recharge, with a minimum floor) for DPS conversion.

nodes.name: calculatePetDamage
nodes.summary: Main pet DPS entry point: resolves the pet entity, applies Mastermind upgrade tiers, aggregates per-ability base/enhanced/final damage across the entity count and duration, and collects non-damage effects.

nodes.name: calculateResolvedPseudoPetDamage
nodes.summary: Computes damage for a resolved pseudo-pet (e.g. rain patches, debuff entities), filtering PvP and inherent-damage tables, honoring powered-up variants, and producing the three-tier ability breakdown.

nodes.name: shouldApplyEnhancements
nodes.summary: Decides whether slotted enhancements copy to a pet's damage based on the entity's CopyBoosts flag.

nodes.name: synthesizePseudoPetEffects
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a PowerEffects-shaped object from a pseudo-pet summon's entity abilities (enhanceable buffs/debuffs and mez), so pet-delivered effects display like native power effects.

nodes.name: getPseudoPetAoEGeometry
nodes.summary: Derives the dominant AoE radius/arc geometry across a pseudo-pet summon's entity abilities.

nodes.name: resolveProcAreaGeometry
nodes.summary: Resolves the area geometry used for proc chance math, preferring the power's direct radius/arc and falling back to pseudo-pet geometry.

nodes.name: power-at-mechanics.ts
nodes.summary: Single source for archetype hit-time damage mechanics — Scrapper/Stalker/Sentinel crits, Corruptor Scourge, Controller Containment — the multiplicative bonuses applied outside the damage cap; deliberately excludes additive strength buffs like Fury and Vigilance, which are already folded into global damage.
nodes.languageNotes: The multiplier intentionally does not apply to proc damage: the planner keeps proc averages flat even though the game crits procs at hit time.

nodes.name: resolveAtMechanic
nodes.summary: Dispatches on archetype context to compute the applicable hit-time mechanic (Scourge, crit, Assassination, Containment, Opportunity) for a power.

nodes.name: atMechanicMultiplier
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper returning just the damage multiplier from resolveAtMechanic.

nodes.name: chain-expressions.ts
nodes.summary: Humanizers for the two chain-power RPN expressions recovered from powers.bin (chainTargetExpression and maxTargetsExpression), turning raw token lists into short player-readable descriptions for the Info panel.

nodes.name: describeChainTarget
nodes.summary: Describes a ChainTarget expression's next-jump rule by testing for stat-deficit clauses (kHitPoints%, kEndurance%, kAbsorb%) versus pure-proximity chains.

nodes.name: describeTargetCap
nodes.summary: Describes a conditional max-targets expression (stack-scaling caps, Gauntlet target cap) in player terms.

nodes.name: format-precision.ts
nodes.summary: The single rounding primitive for every displayed number in the planner: rounds to a declared max number of decimals then strips trailing zeros, so float noise from scale-times-table arithmetic never leaks into the display.

nodes.name: formatPrecision
nodes.summary: Rounds a value to maxDecimals then strips trailing zeros (3.7500001 becomes '3.75', 45 becomes '45').

nodes.name: mode-suppression.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, dependency-free model of CoH combat-mode suppression: active powers that set modes (Granite_Mode, Kheldian form modes) suspend powers carrying those modes in modesSuspended, dropping their effect contribution while keeping endurance cost and set bonuses; shared by the totals calc and the UI suppression hook.
nodes.languageNotes: A suppressed toggle is still on — only its own effect contribution is dropped, so the set-bonus path is deliberately untouched.

nodes.name: computeModeSuppression
nodes.summary: Given the build's active powers, collects the live modes set by active powers and maps each power whose modesSuspended intersects them to its suppression info.

nodes.name: modeLabel
nodes.summary: Formats a raw mode id (e.g. 'Granite_Mode') into a human-readable label for UI display.

nodes.name: DestinyTimeSlider.tsx
nodes.summary: React component rendering the Destiny incarnate decay time-slider, letting users pick a point on the buff's additive-tier decay timeline to see time-scaled effect values.

nodes.name: RuleOf5Banner.tsx
nodes.summary: Banner component warning when set bonuses exceed the Rule of 5 cap, listing offending powers while honoring per-stat over-cap mute preferences.

nodes.name: set-bonus-groups.ts
nodes.summary: Categorization table mapping normalized set-bonus stat keys to display groups and row labels for the Set Bonus Totals popup, with helpers for canonical stat keys and over-cap mute lookups.
nodes.languageNotes: Paired defense/resistance stats (S/L, F/C, E/N) deliberately share a label so engine-emitted pair duplicates collapse to one display row.

nodes.name: useBuildBudget.ts
nodes.summary: Hook computing the level-scoped power-pick and enhancement-slot budget for the current build; single source of truth for dashboard counters and the mobile build bar.

nodes.name: useSlotLevels.ts
nodes.summary: Thin hook exposing computed enhancement-slot assignment levels for the current build by delegating to the slot-levels utility.

nodes.name: useUndoRedoKeyboard.ts
nodes.summary: Hook wiring global Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z keyboard shortcuts to the build undo/redo history store.

nodes.name: buildStore.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zustand store holding the character build: archetype/powerset selection, power picks, enhancement slotting, incarnates, and per-server persisted builds, with dataset sync, undo checkpoints, and import/export wiring.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses zustand persist with custom migrate/merge/partialize to keep one working build per game server; inactive servers' builds are carried as opaque stored blobs.

nodes.name: historyStore.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory undo/redo Zustand store keeping up to 50 Build snapshots; not persisted, so history resets on page reload.

nodes.name: localstorage-polyfill.ts
nodes.summary: In-memory localStorage shim for node-environment vitest runs; must be imported before any store module so zustand's cached JSON storage picks up the working shim instead of Node 22's throwing experimental global.

nodes.name: dataset-switch-overlay.ts
nodes.summary: Renders a full-screen 'switching dataset' overlay for immediate feedback during the page reload required to swap the boot-time dataset singleton to another game server.

nodes.name: over-cap-mute.ts
nodes.summary: Helpers for the per-stat Rule-of-5 over-cap mute feature: computes which powers contribute capped bonuses and counts capped sources whose warnings are not muted.

nodes.name: per-server-builds.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers implementing per-server build storage: one preserved working build per dataset, serialized for JSON persistence, with migration from the old single-slot state and active-build selection.
nodes.languageNotes: Only the active server's build is hydrated; inactive builds are opaque stored blobs re-persisted verbatim since their powers reference an unloaded dataset.

nodes.name: server-deeplink.ts
nodes.summary: Builds absolute ?serverId= deeplink URLs so any server's launcher or site can land visitors on the planner with that server's dataset loaded, without clobbering builds on other servers.

nodes.name: slot-levels.ts
nodes.summary: Core engine assigning character levels to enhancement slots: computes slot placement under respec and leveling progression modes, tracks the slot-grant budget, and validates/applies user slot-level moves.

nodes.name: DestinyTimeSlider
nodes.summary: Slider component reading the Destiny timeline from data helpers and the selected time from the UI store, rendering tier markers along the buff decay curve.

nodes.name: RuleOf5Banner
nodes.summary: Banner component surfacing unmuted Rule-of-5 capped set bonuses with the offending power names, backed by the shared character calculation.

nodes.name: statKeyToLabel
nodes.summary: Resolves a normalized stat key to its display group and row label, falling back to a Misc entry.

nodes.name: toCanonicalStatKey
nodes.summary: Maps divergent stat-key vocabularies (breakdown vs proc-category keys) to the canonical group|label mute key used for over-cap muting.

nodes.name: isOverCapMuted
nodes.summary: Checks whether a stat's over-cap warning has been muted by looking its canonical key up in the muted-set.

nodes.name: useBuildBudget
nodes.summary: Computes power picks used vs granted and enhancement slots placed vs granted at the build's current level, excluding auto-granted powers and freebie slots.

nodes.name: useSlotLevels
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the build store and returns computeAllSlotLevels output for the current build.

nodes.name: useUndoRedoKeyboard
nodes.summary: Registers a window keydown listener translating Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z into build store undo/redo actions, skipping text inputs.

nodes.name: syncBuildDefinitions
nodes.summary: Reconciles a persisted build against the currently loaded dataset: re-resolves power and enhancement references, self-heals renamed or removed definitions, and prunes state that no longer exists.

nodes.name: findPower
nodes.summary: Locates a selected power in the build across primary, secondary, pool, epic, and inherent collections.

nodes.name: findPowerInCategory
nodes.summary: Category-aware power lookup that resolves a power within a specific build category, avoiding cross-category internalName collisions.

nodes.name: countPlacedSlots
nodes.summary: Counts enhancement slots consuming the placement budget, excluding each power's free base slot and auto-granted slots.

nodes.name: countTotalSlots
nodes.summary: Totals all enhancement slots across every power collection in the build for budget enforcement.

nodes.name: isUniqueEnhancementSlotted
nodes.summary: Checks whether a unique enhancement (or its ATO counterpart-set piece) is already slotted anywhere in the build to enforce one-per-build rules.

nodes.name: normalizeBranchPowersets
nodes.summary: Normalizes branch-archetype (e.g. Kheldian/VEAT) powerset selections so branch-specific powersets stay consistent with the detected archetype branch.

nodes.name: detectBranch
nodes.summary: Infers which archetype branch a build is using from its selected powersets.

nodes.name: applyPowerUpdate
nodes.summary: Immutably applies an update function to a matching selected power across all build power collections.

nodes.name: applyToAllPowers
nodes.summary: Maps an update function over every selected power in every collection of the build.

nodes.name: createInherentSelectedPower
nodes.summary: Constructs a SelectedPower entry for an inherent power, including auto-granted slot levels where the inherent grants freebies.

nodes.name: getInherentSelectedPowers
nodes.summary: Builds the full list of inherent selected powers for an archetype, merging archetype-specific and universal inherents.

nodes.name: reconcileInherentSlots
nodes.summary: Reconciles existing inherent powers' slots against current auto-grant rules, preserving user slotting while fixing granted-slot counts.

nodes.name: calculateCorrectLevel
nodes.summary: Determines the correct pick level for a power given occupied pick levels and availability constraints; exported for reuse and testing.

nodes.name: useBuildStore
nodes.summary: The zustand store definition itself: all build mutation actions (power/slot/enhancement/incarnate/settings changes), undo checkpointing, per-server persist with migrate/merge/partialize, and dataset switching.

nodes.name: useHistoryStore
nodes.summary: Zustand store exposing checkpoint/undo/redo/clear over bounded past and future Build snapshot stacks.

nodes.name: showDatasetSwitchOverlay
nodes.summary: Appends a fixed full-screen status overlay with the target server label so users get immediate feedback before the dataset-switch page reload.

nodes.name: computeOffendingPowerReasons
nodes.summary: Derives, per power, the list of Rule-of-5 capped bonus reasons from bonus tracking data, labeling each with its canonical stat group and label.

nodes.name: countUnmutedCappedSources
nodes.summary: Counts capped bonus sources whose over-cap warnings have not been muted, driving the banner's visibility and badge count.

nodes.name: isKnownServerId
nodes.summary: Type guard validating that a string is a known dataset/server id.

nodes.name: serializeBuildForStorage
nodes.summary: Serializes a Build for localStorage, converting Set-valued set-tracking pieces into JSON-safe arrays.

nodes.name: migratePerServerState
nodes.summary: Migrates persisted store state from the old single-build slot to the per-server builds map without losing the existing build.

nodes.name: selectActiveBuild
nodes.summary: Picks the stored build for the active server from the per-server map, falling back to an empty build for that server.

nodes.name: composePersistedState
nodes.summary: Composes the persisted state shape by writing the active build into its server slot while re-persisting inactive servers' opaque blobs verbatim.

nodes.name: serverDeeplink
nodes.summary: Builds an absolute URL with a ?serverId= query param that boots the planner into the given server's dataset, defaulting to the current origin and base path.

nodes.name: countPlacedBudgetSlots
nodes.summary: Counts slots that consume the enhancement-slot budget across a build's powers, excluding free base slots and auto-granted freebies.

nodes.name: collectAllPowers
nodes.summary: Gathers every slottable power from all build collections into a uniform list with category metadata for slot-level computation.

nodes.name: resolveSlotCategory
nodes.summary: Resolves which build category a power belongs to for slot-level bookkeeping, handling inherents and pools.

nodes.name: computeSlotLevelsRespec
nodes.summary: Assigns slot levels under respec rules, where slots can be freely distributed as long as the cumulative grant budget at each level is respected.

nodes.name: computeSlotLevelsLeveling
nodes.summary: Assigns slot levels under strict leveling-order progression, honoring per-level slot grants, user-pinned floors, and power pick levels.

nodes.name: findNextAvailableGrantLevel
nodes.summary: Finds the next character level with an unconsumed slot grant at or after a minimum level, used when placing a new slot.

nodes.name: computeAllSlotLevels
nodes.summary: Top-level entry computing the level assignment for every slot in the build, dispatching to respec or leveling mode.

nodes.name: ensureSlotOrderPopulated
nodes.summary: Backfills missing slot-order metadata on legacy builds so slot-level computation has a stable ordering to work from.

nodes.name: backfillSlotOrderLevels
nodes.summary: Fills in slot-order level values from computed assignments for builds persisted before levels were stored.

nodes.name: isMovableSlot
nodes.summary: Predicate deciding whether a given slot's level can be user-adjusted (not a base or auto-granted slot).

nodes.name: canMoveSlotLevel
nodes.summary: Validates a proposed slot-level move against grant availability, the power's pick level, and existing slot floors.

nodes.name: applySlotLevelMove
nodes.summary: Applies a validated slot-level move to the build, updating slot-order records and displacing conflicting assignments as needed.

nodes.name: canRelocateSlot
nodes.summary: Checks whether a slot can be relocated from one power to another under the current budget and grant constraints.

nodes.name: atom-query.ts
nodes.summary: Plan B Phase 1 atom-native read primitives: read-only helpers that let the calc query a power's decoded atom list by effect type, handle the discriminator axes (enhanceable/resistible/duration/toWho) explicitly, and compute per-stat applier values (ToHit, damage, resistance, defense, MaxHP, regen/recovery, movement, KB protection).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a WeakMap keyed on the Power object as a process-lifetime decode cache, and a narrowed Pick<Power,'atoms'> parameter type so callers need not hold a full Power.

nodes.name: atomic-effect.ts
nodes.summary: DSH4 closed AtomicEffect schema: defines the atomic effect record with compact wire encode/decode, identity and structural keys for differential comparison, and the attrib-to-(effectType, subType) bridge that ingests exported power templates into flat atom lists.
nodes.languageNotes: Zero-import self-contained module; aspect is the deep discriminator in the attrib bridge, and atoms travel as compact tuples (ATOM_TUPLE_FIELDS) on the wire.

nodes.name: atomsOf
nodes.summary: Returns a power's decoded atom list, memoized per Power object via a WeakMap cache.

nodes.name: atomsOfType
nodes.summary: Filters a power's atoms to those of a single effectType.

nodes.name: baseAtoms
nodes.summary: Returns the atoms not behind a conditional gate (the power's base stance effects).

nodes.name: gatedAtoms
nodes.summary: Returns the atoms behind a conditional gate (stance/mode-conditional effects).

nodes.name: baseAtomsOfType
nodes.summary: Combines the base (ungated) filter with an effectType filter.

nodes.name: byType
nodes.summary: Groups an atom list into a Map keyed by effectType.

nodes.name: bySubType
nodes.summary: Groups atoms of one effectType into a Map keyed by subType.

nodes.name: selfDirected
nodes.summary: Filters atoms directed at the caster (toWho Self), the axis the bag flattened into a toWho flag.

nodes.name: targetDirected
nodes.summary: Filters atoms directed at affected targets rather than the caster.

nodes.name: enhanceableVsNot
nodes.summary: Splits atoms on the IgnoreStrength axis into enhanceable and unenhanceable halves, replacing the bag's *Unenhanced parallel slots.

nodes.name: resistibleTwins
nodes.summary: Pairs resistible/unresistable twin atoms that share identity except the resistible flag, replacing the bag's unresistable boolean.

nodes.name: twinKey
nodes.summary: Internal helper building the matching key used to pair resistible twin atoms.

nodes.name: durationBuckets
nodes.summary: Buckets atoms sharing an identity by duration, exposing burst-vs-tail variants the bag collapsed into durationVariants.

nodes.name: perTargetValueOf
nodes.summary: Computes an atom's per-target contribution value, honoring the perTarget converter stamp and stack count.

nodes.name: perTargetFromGroup
nodes.summary: Internal helper resolving per-target stacking values from a group of related atoms.

nodes.name: toHitBuffValue
nodes.summary: Computes a power's ToHit buff total from atoms — the Slice 1 atom-native applier value.

nodes.name: damageBuffValue
nodes.summary: Computes a power's damage-strength buff total from atoms, handling the discriminator axes (gating, per-target, self-direction) explicitly.

nodes.name: resistanceBuffValue
nodes.summary: Computes damage resistance buff totals per damage type from a power's atoms.

nodes.name: resistanceSelfDebuffValue
nodes.summary: Computes self-directed resistance penalties (e.g. Bio Armor Offensive Adaptation's -Res crash) from atoms.

nodes.name: defensePerTypeValue
nodes.summary: Internal helper folding defense atoms into a per-defense-type value map.

nodes.name: defenseBuffByType
nodes.summary: Internal helper computing defense buffs keyed by defense type with stacking and suppression handling.

nodes.name: defenseBuffValue
nodes.summary: Public defense buff totals for non-suppressible defense atoms.

nodes.name: defenseBuffSuppressibleValue
nodes.summary: Defense buff totals for combat-suppressible defense atoms (the suppressible converter stamp).

nodes.name: maxHPBuffValue
nodes.summary: Computes MaxHP buff totals from atoms, summing the enhanceable/unenhanceable twin halves (the Bio Armor halving fix).

nodes.name: resourceBuffValue
nodes.summary: Internal shared core computing regeneration/recovery resource buff totals with slot folding and discriminator handling.

nodes.name: regenBuffValue

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: The tour starts where the browser does: main.tsx applies the persisted color theme before first paint, resolves which game-server dataset (Homecoming, Rebirth, or Thunderspy) is active, installs a chunk-error auto-reload, and mounts the App component inside an error fallback. App.tsx itself is deliberately tiny — it just hands control to the TanStack Router. This split keeps side-effectful startup work (theme, dataset, error handling) out of the React tree.
tour.languageLesson: Vite + React apps bootstrap through createRoot in a plain .tsx entry module. Work done here runs exactly once, before React renders — the right place for theme application and global error hooks that must not flash or re-run.

tour.title: Routing and Layout Shell
tour.description: router.tsx defines the TanStack Router route tree: a root wrapped in MainLayout, planner and shared-build routes, and a settings subtree. MainLayout is the structural skeleton every page lives inside — header, stats dashboard, info panels, banners, modals, the enhancement picker, and mobile navigation, plus global hotkeys. Understanding this file tells you where almost every visible UI element is mounted.
tour.languageLesson: TanStack Router builds routes as typed objects rather than JSX, giving compile-time-checked paths and search params — a contrast to React Router's component-based route declarations.

tour.title: The Domain Vocabulary: Types Layer
tour.description: With 121 files importing it, types/index.ts is the single most depended-upon module in the codebase — the shared vocabulary everything else speaks. build.ts defines the Build model (powerset selections, slotting, attack chains, versioned export formats), while power.ts is the largest type module, describing Power, Powerset, and every effect shape the game data can express (damage, mez, DoT, defense/resistance by-type, summons, movement). Learn these types first and every other layer becomes readable.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript discriminated unions shine for game effects: each effect shape carries a discriminant field, and type-guard helpers let calculation code narrow to the exact shape safely instead of duck-typing.

tour.title: Build State: The Zustand Stores
tour.description: buildStore.ts is the beating heart of user state: archetype and powerset selection, power picks, enhancement slotting, incarnates, and per-server persisted builds, with dataset sync, undo checkpoints, and import/export wiring. Its sibling uiStore.ts (2,100+ lines) owns everything ephemeral — modals, theme, planner layout, tooltips, toasts, exemplar settings. The stores/index.ts barrel is imported by 72 files, making these stores the second-most-connected hub after the types layer.
tour.languageLesson: Zustand stores are plain hooks with selector functions: components subscribe to a narrow slice (useStore(s => s.powers)) and only re-render when that slice changes — critical for a planner where one store backs 150+ component instances.

tour.title: Game Data Layer: Three Servers, One API
tour.description: This is the project's signature architectural trick. dataset.ts defines the Dataset contract and a single active-dataset indirection (loadDataset/getActiveDataset) so Homecoming, Rebirth, and Thunderspy data swap transparently at runtime. Facades like powersets.ts, archetypes.ts, and at-tables.ts route every lookup through whichever dataset is active — at-tables.ts even uses JavaScript Proxies so pre-existing indexed reads keep working unchanged. The data/index.ts barrel (fan-in 80) is the door the rest of the app walks through.
tour.languageLesson: A Proxy can turn a module-level constant into a live indirection: AT_TABLES looks like a plain object, but every property read is routed to the currently active dataset at call time — a migration technique that preserves old import paths while changing what backs them.

tour.title: How Game Data Is Modeled
tour.description: The data layer's README explains the layering discipline: generated/ output from the binary game-data pipeline is authoritative, overrides are the exception, and it documents the composed-file shapes. atomic-effect.ts is the conceptual core beneath it — a closed AtomicEffect schema with compact wire encoding, identity/structural keys for differential comparison, and the attrib-to-(effectType, subType) bridge that turns exported game power templates into flat lists of atomic effects. This mirrors how the game itself models a power: not named fields, but a flat array of atoms.

tour.title: The Calculation Engine
tour.description: character-totals.ts is the heavyweight of the codebase — highest fan-out at 34 imports — aggregating set bonuses, active power effects, procs, accolades, incarnates, and buff-pet auras into final character stats with per-stat breakdowns. damage.ts handles power damage from AT scale tables, DoT tick expectations (including geometric cancel-on-miss math), and Arcana cast time. The calculations/index.ts barrel exposes roughly 140 symbols, making this the app's computational public API. Everything the Stats Dashboard shows flows out of here.

tour.title: Enhancement and Set-Bonus Math
tour.description: Building on the engine from Step 7, enhancement-values.ts implements the game's enhancement rules: IO value schedules by level, Enhancement Diversification (ED) diminishing-returns curves, exemplar scaling, and per-power bonus aggregation including Alpha incarnate combination. io-sets.ts is the facade that turns raw dataset set data into typed IOSet objects, and set-bonuses.ts aggregates bonuses across the whole build with Rule-of-5 cap tracking — the rule that only five copies of the same bonus count.

tour.title: Proc Mechanics
tour.description: Procs — enhancements with a chance to fire an effect — get their own subsystem. proc-data.ts is the central proc database and math library: every IO-set proc entry, the full PPM (procs-per-minute) chance formula, area-factor geometry, and stacking resolution. power-proc-damage.ts computes the flat per-cast damage of slotted damage procs, deliberately shared by both the damage display and the Attack Chain builder's DPS so the two can never diverge — a good example of the project's single-source-of-truth discipline.

tour.title: The Reactive Bridge: Calculation Hooks
tour.description: Between the pure calculation engine and the UI sits the hooks layer. useCalculatedStats.ts exposes the unified character-totals calculation to React: stat conversion, per-stat breakdowns, Rule-of-5 tracking, and over-cap reasons — all backed by a module-level single-entry cache so that 150+ component instances share one calculation run instead of each recomputing it. The hooks/index.ts barrel (fan-in 20) is how components consume this layer.
tour.languageLesson: A module-level cache keyed on a dependency tuple sits outside React entirely: every hook instance checks the same cache entry, so a state change triggers one expensive recomputation, not one per subscribed component. This pattern fixed a real ~1s UI stall in this codebase.

tour.title: The Planner UI
tour.description: Now the pieces assemble on screen. PlannerPage.tsx composes the power sections, docked/popped-out info panel, and set-bonus popup into a user-customizable multi-column grid with drag-to-reorder and column resizing. PowerRow.tsx is the workhorse row for each taken power (slots, toggle state, perma-ring, set bonuses); EnhancementPicker.tsx is the slotting UI with IO sets, procs, and set-bonus previews; InfoPanel.tsx is the largest display component, rendering full power detail; and StatsDashboard.tsx is the central read-out of the entire calculation pipeline from Steps 7-10.

tour.title: Import, Export, and Build Sharing
tour.description: Finally, builds leave and enter the app. ExportImportModal.tsx handles every path: shareable build-hash links, Mids Reborn .mbd/.mxd imports, in-game export parsing, and forum/popmenu/print exports. The mids-import module parses the competing planner's file format so players can migrate. On the cloud side, supabase.ts creates the singleton client and sharedBuilds.ts implements the shared-builds repository — publishing, search, favorites, view counts, and anonymous owner tokens — which BuildsPage.tsx surfaces as a searchable community build browser.
